Thank you for your letter of last month.
This one is rendered by the format as the documentation site is published, so it shows the layout rather than describing it.

The address block above the salutation comes from `address`, and the subject line under it from `subject`, `subject-title`, and `subject-suffix`.
The sender's name and address come from Quarto's own `author` block.

Below the closing, the carbon copies, the enclosures, and the postscript are each set from their own option, and each is left out when it is not given.
